wedo_instance.description: The metabolic bridge for Bulk Ingestion of remote intentions from multiple Pull Requests.

meta.philosophy: Conscious Duality: The shared thread of attention between Remote Intent (Rider) and Local Execution (Machinery).
meta.instruction: Scan ALL open PRs. Ingest every identified intent (e.g., 'WEDO' or '- [ ] WeDo:') into a consolidated instance of this file in the day's chrono-fractal.

protocols.name: Audit Scrutiny
protocols.rule: Every task must be granularly documented with its source PR URL and a forensic report of its localhost resolution.

protocols.name: Hostile Environment Verification
protocols.rule: The machinery MUST verify all artifacts on the localhost. Remote-only tasks must be flagged as USER_REQUIRED.

protocols.name: Bulk Ingestion
protocols.rule: Default to consolidating multiple PRs into a single session thread to minimize context-switching heat.

tasks.description: Bulk Scan: Fetch patches for all open PRs and identify active intentions.
OPERATOR SIGN-OFF: Present the consolidated summarized intentions for Human review. I CANNOT proceed until you explicitly approve the execution of specific WeDo IDs.
ID Assignment: Assign unique session-based WeDo IDs to approved tasks.
Localhost Execution: Perform the approved modifications on the sovereign filesystem.
Synthesis Report: Generate a unified Synthesis Report meeting the Audit Scrutiny standard.
